16% p.a. A $250,000 second mortgage facility. Security is residential property across East Killara on Sydney's Upper North Shore, Silverwater in Western Sydney, and Tugun, Varsity Lakes and Robina on Queensland's Gold Coast. Three repayment options are contemplated: refinance of the existing mortgage facilities with a major bank or approved lender, sale of one or more of the security properties, and repayment from verified borrower or guarantor funds or other available liquidity. Loan amount $250,000. Investor return 16% p.a. Term 3 months, with an option to extend a further 3 months. LVR 87%, inclusive of first mortgages. Image for illustration purposes only.
